<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">
<title>${TITLE@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:,">
<style>
/* tokens — design-inbox/styles/tokens.css (:root rescoped to .auth-root) */
@font-face { font-family: "ManropeFallback"; src: local("Manrope"); }
.auth-root { --font: "Manrope", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; --font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; --ink: #1d1d1f; --ink-2: #56607a; --ink-3: #9aa0ad; --surface: #ffffff; --surface-2:#f5f5f7; --base: #eef1f6; --glass: 255,255,255; --hair: 0,0,0; --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,.70); --glass-blur: blur(24px) saturate(180%); --shadow-card: 0 8px 28px rgba(13,38,76,.10), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.70); --shadow-float: 0 12px 40px rgba(13,38,76,.16), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.80); --radius-pill: 999px; --radius-card: 22px; --radius-lg: 24px; --radius-md: 14px; --radius-sm: 11px; --ok: #1f8a44; --ok-bg: rgba(52,199,89,.16); --warn: #b5670a; --warn-bg: rgba(255,159,10,.16); --danger: #c0392b; --danger-bg: rgba(255,59,48,.12); --info: #0e8fc4; --info-bg: rgba(14,143,196,.16); --accent: #0a5ae6; --accent-2: #2a7bff; --accent-3: #3a90ff; --accent-rgb:10,90,230; --bg-1: #cfe0ff; --bg-2: #d2f4ec; --bg-3: #e7dcff; --app-bg: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 0% 0%, var(--bg-1) 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(110% 90% at 100% 0%, var(--bg-2) 0%, transparent 44%), radial-gradient(120% 120% at 90% 100%, var(--bg-3) 0%, transparent 50%), var(--base); }
.auth-root[data-theme="snow"] { --accent:#0e8fc4; --accent-2:#27a6dd; --accent-3:#46b6e6; --accent-rgb:14,143,196; --bg-1:#cfe9f6; --bg-2:#d4eef4; --bg-3:#dee9f7; }
.auth-root[data-theme="lawn"] { --accent:#2f9e44; --accent-2:#3fb657; --accent-3:#5fce74; --accent-rgb:47,158,68; --bg-1:#d8f0d6; --bg-2:#e4f4d8; --bg-3:#ebf3df; }
.auth-root[data-theme="pool"] { --accent:#0d9488; --accent-2:#15b3a4; --accent-3:#34ccbd; --accent-rgb:13,148,136; --bg-1:#cfeeea; --bg-2:#d6f1ec; --bg-3:#ddeff2; }
.auth-root[data-theme="roofing"] { --accent:#4f46e5; --accent-2:#6d63f5; --accent-3:#8b82ff; --accent-rgb:79,70,229; --bg-1:#dcdaf8; --bg-2:#e6e2fb; --bg-3:#efe6fb; }
.auth-root[data-theme="pest"] { --accent:#7c3aed; --accent-2:#9554f5; --accent-3:#ad74ff; --accent-rgb:124,58,237; --bg-1:#e7dcfb; --bg-2:#efe2fb; --bg-3:#f2e1f6; }
.auth-root[data-theme="health"] { --accent:#0b7285; --accent-2:#0f8ba0; --accent-3:#22a5bb; --accent-rgb:11,114,133; --bg-1:#cfe8ee; --bg-2:#d9eef0; --bg-3:#e2ecf6; }
.auth-root[data-theme="beauty"] { --accent:#d6336c; --accent-2:#e64980; --accent-3:#f06595; --accent-rgb:214,51,108; --bg-1:#fbd9e5; --bg-2:#fde2ec; --bg-3:#f7e3f5; }
.auth-root[data-mode="dark"] { --ink:#eef2f8; --ink-2:#aab6c8; --ink-3:#7f8aa0; --surface:#1b2230; --surface-2:#151b29; --base:#0d1320; --glass:38,46,64; --hair:255,255,255; --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,.14); --shadow-card: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06); --shadow-float: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08); --app-bg: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 0% 0%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.24) 0%, transparent 48%), radial-gradient(110% 90% at 100% 0%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.14) 0%, transparent 46%), radial-gradient(120% 120% at 90% 100%, rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.18) 0%, transparent 52%), var(--base); }

/* base — design-inbox/styles/base.css, scoped */
.auth-root *, .auth-root *::before, .auth-root *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; }
.auth-root { font-family: var(--font); color: var(--ink); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
.auth-root a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; }
.auth-root a:hover { color: var(--accent-2); }
.auth-root button { font-family: inherit; }

/* brand — design-inbox/styles/shell.css */
.brand-logo { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 9px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--accent-3), var(--accent)); display: grid; place-items: center; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5); flex-shrink: 0; }
.brand-logo::after { content: ""; width: 11px; height: 11px; background: var(--surface); border-radius: 3px; transform: rotate(45deg); }
.brand-logo--lg { width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 13px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.3); }
.brand-logo--lg::after { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 4px; }
.brand-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -.01em; white-space: nowrap; }

/* primitives — design-inbox/styles/components.css */
.btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; padding: 9px 16px; white-space: nowrap; transition: transform .08s, filter .15s; }
.btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.btn[disabled] { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }
.btn--primary { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-2), var(--accent)); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(var(--accent-rgb), .35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4); }
.btn--primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); }
.btn--block { display: flex; width: 100%; }
.btn--lg { padding: 11px 20px; font-weight: 700; }
.field-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-2); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.field { width: 100%; padding: 11px 13px; border-radius: 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink); background: rgba(var(--glass), .6); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); outline: none; }
.field:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb), .14); }
.field[data-state="invalid"] { border-color: var(--danger); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 69, 58, .1); }
.field-error { font-size: 12px; color: var(--danger); }

/* composition — design-inbox/styles/routes.css */
.eyebrow { display: inline-block; background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.10); color: var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); padding: 6px 14px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; }
.auth-page { min-height: 78vh; }
.auth-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 420px; gap: 40px; align-items: center; padding-top: 12px; }
.auth-pitch { padding: 0 10px; }
.auth-pitch__title { margin: 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: 42px; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -.03em; }
.auth-pitch .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 18px; }
.auth-pitch__sub { margin: 16px 0 26px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 400px; }
.auth-card { position: relative; background: rgba(var(--glass),.62); backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(180%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85); border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(8,24,60,.22); padding: 30px; }

/* page — design-inbox/styles/core-auth-login.css */
.auth-page { min-height: 100vh; min-height: 100dvh; background: var(--app-bg); background-attachment: fixed; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; }
.auth-inner { margin-block: auto; width: 100%; max-width: 1120px; margin-inline: auto; padding: 40px 22px 56px; }
.auth-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 440px; gap: 48px; padding-top: 0; }
.auth-pitch { order: 1; min-width: 0; }
.auth-card { order: 2; min-width: 0; border-color: var(--glass-border); }
.auth-pitch__title { text-wrap: pretty; }
.auth-pitch__sub { margin-bottom: 0; max-width: 420px; text-wrap: pretty; }
a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.auth-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.auth-title { margin: 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.auth-sub { margin: 6px 0 20px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink-2); text-wrap: pretty; }
.auth-note { margin: 18px 0 0; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink-3); text-wrap: pretty; }
.auth-msg { border-radius: 18px; padding: 13px 15px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.auth-msg__inner { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }
.auth-msg__glyph { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; flex-shrink: 0; }
.auth-msg__text { min-width: 0; }
.auth-msg__title { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.auth-msg__body { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink-2); text-wrap: pretty; }
.auth-msg--error { background: var(--danger-bg); border: 1px solid rgba(255,59,48,.28); }
.auth-msg--error .auth-msg__glyph { background: rgba(255,59,48,.20); color: var(--danger); }
.auth-msg--error .auth-msg__title { font-weight: 800; color: var(--danger); }
.auth-root[data-mode="dark"] .auth-msg--error .auth-msg__title, .auth-root[data-mode="dark"] .auth-msg--error .auth-msg__glyph { color: #ff8b80; }
.auth-msg--logout { background: rgba(var(--glass),.55); border: 1px solid rgba(var(--hair),.10); }
.auth-msg--logout .auth-msg__glyph { background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid rgba(var(--hair),.20); color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 13px; }
.auth-msg--logout .auth-msg__title { font-weight: 650; color: var(--ink); }
.auth-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.field-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 12px; }
.field-head .field-label { flex-shrink: 0; }
.auth-link { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .01em; white-space: nowrap; }
.field-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; }
.field-wrap .field { padding-inline-end: 74px; }
.auth-reveal { position: absolute; inset-block: 4px; inset-inline-end: 5px; min-width: 58px; padding-inline: 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(var(--hair),.05); color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
.auth-reveal:hover { background: rgba(var(--hair),.09); color: var(--ink); }
.auth-reveal[hidden] { display: none; }
.auth-reveal[aria-pressed="false"] .auth-reveal__off, .auth-reveal[aria-pressed="true"] .auth-reveal__on { display: none; }
.auth-submit { margin-top: 4px; padding: 14px 20px; font-size: 15px; }
@media (max-width: 900px) { .auth-inner { padding: 28px 20px 44px; max-width: 560px; } .auth-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 26px; } .auth-card { order: 1; } .auth-pitch { order: 2; padding-inline: 4px; } .auth-pitch__title { font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .auth-pitch__sub { font-size: 14px; margin-top: 10px; max-width: none; } .auth-pitch .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 12px; } }
@media (max-width: 560px) { .auth-inner { padding: 16px 14px 36px; } .auth-card { padding: 20px 18px; border-radius: 24px; } .auth-head { gap: 11px; margin-bottom: 14px; } .auth-head .brand-logo--lg { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 11px; } .auth-head .brand-logo--lg::after { width: 13px; height: 13px; } .auth-title { font-size: 21px; } .auth-sub { font-size: 13.5px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .auth-msg { padding: 11px 13px; margin-bottom: 13px; border-radius: 16px; } .auth-msg__inner { gap: 10px; } .auth-msg__glyph { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 8px; } .auth-form { gap: 13px; } .auth-form .field { font-size: 16px; padding: 13px 14px; } .auth-submit { padding: 15px 20px; } .auth-note { margin-top: 14px; } }
</style>
html:
${BRAND_NAME@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

${CARD_TITLE@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

${CARD_SUBTITLE@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

!

${ERROR_TITLE@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

${ERROR_BODY@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

✓

${LOGOUT_TITLE@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

${LOGOUT_BODY@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

${FORGOT_PASSWORD@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

${CARD_NOTE@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

${PITCH_EYEBROW@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

${PITCH_TITLE@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

${PITCH_BODY@LOCALIZED_STRING_SS}

en.NAME: Palette
en.DESCRIPTION: hvac | snow | lawn | pool | roofing | pest | health | beauty

en.NAME: Mode
en.DESCRIPTION: light | dark

en.NAME: Document title
en.DESCRIPTION: Browser tab title for the sign-in page.

en.NAME: Brand name
en.DESCRIPTION: Brand shown beside the mark at the top of the card.

en.NAME: Card title
en.DESCRIPTION: Heading of the sign-in card.

en.NAME: Card subtitle
en.DESCRIPTION: One line under the heading telling the customer what to do.

value.en: Enter your username and password to continue.

en.NAME: Error title
en.DESCRIPTION: Heading of the assertive region shown when the previous attempt failed. Never names which field was wrong.

en.NAME: Error body
en.DESCRIPTION: Body of the failed-attempt message.

value.en: Check your username and password, then try again.

en.NAME: Logout title
en.DESCRIPTION: Heading of the polite region shown after a normal sign-out.

en.NAME: Logout body
en.DESCRIPTION: Body of the signed-out confirmation.

value.en: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

en.NAME: Username label
en.DESCRIPTION: Label of the username field. The field name itself is fixed and is not a parameter.

en.NAME: Password label
en.DESCRIPTION: Label of the password field. The field name itself is fixed and is not a parameter.

en.NAME: Password reset link
en.DESCRIPTION: Text of the password-reset link. Its URL comes from core-auth at request time.

en.NAME: Show password
en.DESCRIPTION: Label of the reveal control while the password is hidden. Enhancement only — absent without JavaScript.

en.NAME: Hide password
en.DESCRIPTION: Label of the reveal control while the password is visible.

en.NAME: Submit button
en.DESCRIPTION: Label of the submit button.

en.NAME: Card note
en.DESCRIPTION: Anti-phishing note under the form.

value.en: We will never ask for your password by email, message or phone.

en.NAME: Pitch eyebrow
en.DESCRIPTION: Small chip above the explanatory column.

en.NAME: Pitch title
en.DESCRIPTION: Heading of the explanatory column, hidden below 900px until after the form.

value.en: You’re signing in on the account service.

en.NAME: Pitch body
en.DESCRIPTION: Body of the explanatory column: why the customer landed here and where they go next.

value.en: The portal sent you here because this is the only page where your password is entered. Once you’re signed in, you’ll be taken straight back to where you started.

en.NAME: Calm Harbor · Customer Portal Login
en.DESCRIPTION: CMS skin for the core-auth login page. Standalone root template: no children, no third-party assets, and no dependency on JavaScript. core-auth substitutes LOGIN_ACTION, CSRF_PARAMETER_NAME, CSRF_TOKEN, RESET_PASSWORD_URL, ERROR_DISPLAY and LOGOUT_DISPLAY at request time.
